workflowCorpus.split: one verified task is visible calibration; no held-out task or oracle is included
workflowCorpus.heldoutReservation: whole substrate/template/fault-family identities reserved before tuning in the corpus manifest; metadata only, no isolation claim
workflowCorpus.redGreenAndAdequacyEvidence: test/campaign-workflows.test.ts: one real seeded review repair has an independent executable red/green oracle; reference and distinct alternative patches pass; exported host judge and typed runSuite adapter pass under injected Driver; five other local operations now have exported family-specific judges but remain integration scenarios, and test-fix exposes a broad package-scope gap
workflowCorpus.scenarioCountMeaning: 14 named Vitest workflow cases include review output-fault cases, bounded candidate-module execution, and runSuite adapter smoke; they are not 14 independent repair tasks
workflowCorpus.independentSubstrates: five fresh local filesystem substrates; only review-loop has an independently judged repair task
workflowCorpus.coverageLimit: one independently judged review-loop task; five additional operation scenarios have reusable host judges but no role calls; no role adequacy claim or 20-task-per-role adequacy claim; test-fix scope is too broad
workflowCorpus.hostJudge: runner/workflow-corpus/review-loop-judge.ts exports judgeReviewLoopWorkspace and judgeReviewLoopRepairTask; semantic conformance accepts multiple implementations, executes arbitrary candidate modules in a 5000ms child process, and candidate identity separately hashes actual patch bytes
workflowCorpus.runSuiteAdapter: runner/workflow-corpus/review-loop-suite.ts exports typed SuiteCase adapter and deterministic local runSuite bundle; wrapDriver pins materialized baseline SHA before dispatch and preserves candidate commits under a side ref for baseline-relative patch capture
workflowCorpus.toolkitTestFixFinding: pinned dd247ca source test-fix.ts:64-66 omits stagePathAllowlist; sweep.ts:392-395,417-418 therefore applies package-prefix default; details and reproduction in runner/workflow-corpus/README.md
workflowCorpus.pristineBaselineIntegrity: review task factory creates a fresh local Git seed; runSuite adapter captures the actual materialized workspace baseline before delegation, supplies its full SHA and pinned semantic oracle through hostCheckScoringEnvironment, and handles model-created commits; no toolkit or fixtures checkout was mutated
